milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close enough to the red mushroom (placed at spawn-relative 5, 1, 5 on mycelium) and face toward it, confirming visual identification. max_distance=5 requires actual navigation since the mushroom is ~7.07 blocks from spawn diagonally — the player must close at least ~2 blocks of that gap. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the mushroom, not just passing by.
